{{Quote|They're a type of hot-world shrub that grows on the system's inner planet. You can get about eight different exotic medicines and twice that number of food flavorings out of them.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The inner '''planet''' of the [[Sif'kric system/Legends|Sif'kric system]] was located in the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[pommwomm]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], used by the [[Sif'krie]] to produce [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and medicine. Export of pommwomm plants made up about 20% of the [[Sif'kric]] economy.<ref name="SotP" />
